key_insight: QAOA and FALQON follow distinct entanglement and coherence trajectories as they approach optimal Minimum Vertex Cover solutions.
engineering_relevance: Tracking these resources without full state tomography can help characterize circuit-depth demands and optimization dynamics on near-term quantum devices.
method: Apply QAOA and FALQON to a Minimum Vertex Cover instance.
Optimize an auxiliary quantum circuit to identify closest resource-free states using the Bures metric and Uhlmann’s theorem.
Track Bures entanglement and coherence through the optimization process.
evidence_signal: For the studied instance, QAOA shows an early pronounced entanglement peak and residual coherence, while FALQON shows a lower, later entanglement peak and smoothly decreasing coherence.
watch_item: The abstract reports one problem instance, so generalization to larger graphs and the overhead of auxiliary-circuit optimization remain open concerns.
paper_title: Resource Analysis of Quantum Optimization Algorithms via Variational Methods
